rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a timetable or planned sequence of activities and their times.

example.english: I've already looked at this week's schedule.
example.traditional: 我已經睇過今個星期嘅時間表喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 ging1 tai2 gwo3 gam1 go3 sing1 kei4 ge3 si4 gaan3 biu2 laa3

rows.note: Use this for the planned allocation of time when you mean the arrangement rather than a timetable document.

example.english: My schedule is so packed that I don't even have time to rest on Saturday.
example.traditional: 我嘅時間安排得好密，星期六都冇位休息。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ge3 si4 gaan3 on1 paai4 dak1 hou2 mat6 sing1 kei4 luk6 dou1 mou5 wai2 jau1 sik1

rows.note: Use this for a person’s or group’s itinerary, especially a trip or a sequence of appointments and activities.

example.english: This is my schedule for the days I'm in Taipei.
example.traditional: 呢張係我去台北嗰幾日嘅行程表。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 hai6 ngo5 heoi3 toi4 bak1 go2 gei2 jat6 ge3 hang4 cing4 biu2

rows.note: Use this when the schedule is a set of assigned dates or slots, especially for appointments, productions, or releases.

example.english: The surgery schedule is set for the fifteenth of next month.
example.traditional: 個手術已經排期喺下個月十五號。
example.jyutping: go3 sau2 seot6 ji5 ging1 paai4 kei4 hai2 haa6 go3 jyut6 sap6 ng5 hou6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for planning an event or arranging someone’s activities for a particular time.

example.english: I will schedule a meeting for tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 on1 paai4 ting1 jat6 hoi1 wui5

rows.note: Use this when assigning an official date or slot, especially for events, productions, or scheduled participation.

example.english: The broadcaster will schedule this drama to air in August.
example.traditional: 電視台會幫呢套劇排期八月播。
example.jyutping: din6 si6 toi4 wui5 bong1 ni1 tou3 kek6 paai4 kei4 baat3 jyut6 bo3

rows.note: Use this when reserving an appointment, place, or time in advance rather than merely planning it.

example.english: I want to schedule a dentist appointment for next week.
example.traditional: 我想預約下星期嘅牙醫。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jyu6 joek3 haa6 sing1 kei4 ge3 ngaa4 ji1

rows.note: Use this specifically for creating or working out a timetable.

example.english: We need to schedule all the classes for next term.
example.traditional: 我哋要排時間表，安排晒下學期啲堂。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 paai4 si4 gaan3 biu2 on1 paai4 saai3 haa6 hok6 kei4 di1 tong4
